source_page_content:
Larkspur Research Imaging Centre

The Centre serves laboratories affiliated with Larkspur Institute and approved external research groups. Internal users must be listed on an active institute laboratory account. The principal investigator must submit the laboratory access form before any member may request instrument time. Visiting scholars may be added to a laboratory roster when sponsored by an institute principal investigator and when the visitor access agreement is signed.

External academic and nonprofit groups may apply through an institute sponsor. Access begins only after the Centre approves the application and receives a signed service agreement. Commercial users must contact the Centre manager for a project review before scheduling.

Reservations

Approved users request instrument time through the Centre's online booking calendar. Requests must be submitted at least two business days before the requested session. Reservations may be made up to 30 calendar days in advance. Users must cancel or amend a session at least 12 hours before its start; later cancellations are billed for the reserved time. A standard session may not exceed four consecutive hours, and an individual may reserve no more than eight hours per week. The Centre manager may approve longer sessions for time-sensitive projects.

Rates

For the confocal microscope, internal institute users are charged $42 per hour for independently operated sessions and $68 per hour for staff-assisted sessions. Approved external academic and nonprofit users are charged $95 per hour for independently operated sessions and $140 per hour for staff-assisted sessions. Staff-assisted rates apply whenever a Centre staff member operates the instrument. Rates are billed in whole-hour increments. No waiver or discount is listed on this page. Commercial rates are quoted after project review.

Equipment use

Only users with current Centre authorization may operate the confocal microscope independently. Independent operation requires completion of the Centre's instrument-specific training and a competency check. Users who have not completed the competency check must book a staff-assisted session. Live-cell imaging must be staff-assisted. Samples presenting an uncontained biological or chemical hazard are not accepted.

Facility access

The imaging suite is open to authorized users from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Monday through Friday. Access outside these hours is limited to users with after-hours card access approved by the Centre manager. Visitors must remain with their institute sponsor or Centre staff member while inside the suite.

Policy effective March 1, 2025.
